 VOLLEY Choco Mucho eliminates PLDT, completes semis cast
 Mark Escarlote · 19 November 2026 · 10:01 PM PHT · 2 MIN READ 
 Sisi Rondina-Rosales drops 21 points in Choco Mucho's 25-22, 25-23, 18-25, 25-23, win over PLDT to secure a semifinals seat in the PVL Season 10 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series.
 Photograph courtesy of PVL
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save Choco Mucho completed the semifinals cast after booting out PLDT, 25-22, 25-23, 18-25, 25-23, in a virtual do-or-die elimination round clash in the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Season 10 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
 Sisi Rondina-Rosales blasted all her 21 points on attacks to lead the Flying Titans’ assault for a 5-3 win-loss record.
 Choco Mucho’s four-set victory also towed sister team defending champion Creamline into the next round via superior set ratio over the High Speed Hitters even if it loses against Final Four-bound Farm Fresh on Saturday.
 Also read ICC, LPU-B spikers rule UCAL 
 Eya Laure added 11 markers, all from kills including the match-clinching kill to end the two-hour, 11-minute showdown. 
 Libero Dawn Macandili-Catindig submitted a double-double of 13 digs and 12 excellent receptions in an efficient defensive showing for the Flying Titans, who returned to the semis for the first time since a fourth-place finish in the 2024-2025 2nd AFC.
 PLDT finished its campaign with a 4-4 record.
 Savi Davison poured a triple-double of 30 points, 26 from kills, 22 excellent receptions and 10 digs in a losing effort for the High Speed Hitters. 
 Dell Palomata got five of her nine points on kill blocks while Jessa Ordiales and Alleiah Malaluan had seven points each for PLDT.
